summary: Learn to install, use, and manage OPENHDS and ODK effectively. Our course provide essential insights and hands-on experience for all skill levels.
lede: OpenHDS and ODK training connects household registration and demographic event histories with mobile data collection. It is for coordinators, data managers, form designers, and supervisors who manage health and demographic surveillance workflows. Participants practise modelling household and resident records, building and testing XLSForms, managing ODK submissions, and checking data for duplicates and inconsistencies.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who configure, supervise, analyse, or govern digital health and demographic surveillance workflows. It is appropriate for foundation to intermediate learners who need practical exposure to OpenHDS and ODK without assuming software engineering experience.
prerequisites: You should have basic experience with digital data collection, health or demographic surveillance, research operations, or database-supported programme work. No programming is required for completion, although comfort with spreadsheets, Android devices, and structured data will help. Advanced topics such as REST API integration, PostgreSQL administration, and AI-assisted anomaly review receive conceptual or operational treatment rather than production-engineering treatment. Bring a laptop and, where possible, an Android device for form-testing exercises.
